name: financial-analytics-dashboard
description: Production-grade healthcare revenue analytics platform with Node.js microservices and React frontend
author: Your Name

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:backend: cd backend/shared && npm install && cd ../api-gateway && npm install && cd ../auth-service && npm install && cd ../analytics-service && npm install && cd ../data-service && npm install && cd ../reporting-service && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:analytics" "npm run dev:data" "npm run dev:reporting" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: cd backend/api-gateway && npm run build && cd ../auth-service && npm run build && cd ../analytics-service && npm run build && cd ../data-service && npm run build && cd ../reporting-service && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:analytics" "npm run start:data" "npm run start:reporting"
scripts.migrate: cd backend/shared && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.migrate:dev: cd backend/shared && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.migrate:reset: cd backend/shared && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend/api-gateway && npm test && cd ../auth-service && npm test && cd ../analytics-service && npm test && cd ../data-service && npm test && cd ../reporting-service && npm test
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend/api-gateway && npm run lint && cd ../auth-service && npm run lint && cd ../analytics-service && npm run lint && cd ../data-service && npm run lint && cd ../reporting-service && npm run lint
scripts.clean:install: npm run clean && npm run install:all
